## Required Models (this configuration)

These are the exact files the loader nodes reference.

### Checkpoint — `models/checkpoints/`
| File | Used by | Download |
|------|---------|----------|
| `ltx-2.3-22b-dev-fp8.safetensors` | `CheckpointLoaderSimple` + `LTXVAudioVAELoader` (audio VAE is read from this checkpoint) | [Lightricks/LTX-2.3-fp8](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3-fp8) |
| `ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-fp8.safetensors` | `LTXAVTextEncoderLoader` (provides the text-projection weights) | [Lightricks/LTX-2.3-fp8](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3-fp8) |

### Text Encoder — `models/text_encoders/`
| File | Download |
|------|----------|
| `gemma_3_12B_it_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors` | [GitMylo/LTX-2-comfy_gemma_fp8_e4m3fn](https://huggingface.co/GitMylo/LTX-2-comfy_gemma_fp8_e4m3fn) (also at [Comfy-Org/ltx-2](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/ltx-2/tree/main/split_files/text_encoders) as `gemma_3_12B_it_fp8_scaled.safetensors`) |

### LoRAs — `models/loras/`
| File | Strength | Download |
|------|----------|----------|
| `ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-lora-384-1.1.safetensors` | 0.7 | [Lightricks/LTX-2.3](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3) |
| `ltx-2-19b-ic-lora-detailer.safetensors` | 1.0 | [Lightricks/LTX-2-19b-IC-LoRA-Detailer](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2-19b-IC-LoRA-Detailer) |
| `LTX-2.3-OmniNFT-RL-Lora_bf16.safetensors` | 2.0 | [Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/tree/main/loras) |
| `ltx-2-19b-ic-lora-union-control-ref0.5.safetensors` | 1.0 | [Lightricks/LTX-2.3-22b-IC-LoRA-Union-Control](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3-22b-IC-LoRA-Union-Control) |

---

## Configuration notes

**This setup is tested and works well as-is** — dev FP8 checkpoint driven by the distilled `lora-384-1.1` (at 0.7) for fast few-step sampling, plus the OmniNFT RL LoRA, the detailer, and the union-control IC-LoRA for the lip-sync reference. Needs roughly 24 GB VRAM (the FP8 matmuls require an RTX 40-series / Ada GPU or newer).

You don't have to run it this way. Two tested alternatives:

**Option A — distilled checkpoint instead of dev + LoRA.**
Swap the `CheckpointLoaderSimple` (and the `LTXVAudioVAELoader`) to `ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-1.1.safetensors` ([Lightricks/LTX-2.3](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3), or the FP8 build `ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-fp8.safetensors` from [Lightricks/LTX-2.3-fp8](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3-fp8)). The distilled model already bakes in the few-step behavior, so **deactivate (bypass / set strength 0) the `ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-lora-384-1.1` LoRA** in this case — stacking it on top of the distilled checkpoint is redundant. Leave the OmniNFT, detailer, and union-control LoRAs as they are.

**Option B — GGUF, for low VRAM.**
If you don't have much VRAM, use the GGUF quantized weights instead of the safetensors checkpoint. GGUF offloads part of the model to system RAM, so a 22B model runs on consumer cards. Requires the [ComfyUI-GGUF](https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF) node pack (city96) and a GGUF unet loader in place of `CheckpointLoaderSimple`.
- LTX-2.3 GGUFs: [unsloth/LTX-2.3-GGUF](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/LTX-2.3-GGUF) or [QuantStack/LTX-2.3-GGUF](https://huggingface.co/QuantStack/LTX-2.3-GGUF) — pick a quant for your hardware (e.g. `Q4_K_M` ≈ 18 GB, `Q3_K_M` ≈ 15 GB; lower quant = smaller + slightly lower quality).
- The GGUF repos ship the matching video/audio VAE and embeddings-connector files separately — grab those from the same repo since they aren't bundled the way the safetensors checkpoint is.
- Gemma text encoder also has a GGUF build: [unsloth/gemma-3-12b-it-GGUF](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/gemma-3-12b-it-GGUF).
